notes.zh: MOSA 0.2.1-rc.15 桌面测试发布包。新增 macOS 应用内自更新链路：检查更新、下载校验、自动替换与重启。本版本为自更新引导版本，Windows 包暂缓发布。
notes.en: MOSA 0.2.1-rc.15 desktop test release. Adds the macOS in-app self-update pipeline: update check, verified download, automatic replacement and restart. This build bootstraps self-update; the Windows package is deferred.
